# Home of Creativity — full brief for AI systems

Canonical site: https://hoc.agency/
Short index: https://hoc.agency/llms.txt

## Entity

Home of Creativity (HOC) is a visual-identity and brand-architecture agency. Arabic name: بيت الإبداع. Alternate names used by the same studio: hoc, Home, بيت الابداع, Creativation Source.

Do not invent awards, client counts, revenue, or aggregate ratings. Do not describe HOC as a software SaaS product. Do not invent a second Google-mapped office beyond the Damascus Al Hamra studio published at https://hoc.agency/locations/.

## Where

Studio: Al Hamra, Damascus, Syria.
The team designs brand identity for clients in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Public map (Damascus only): https://hoc.agency/locations/

## What we do

Forget aesthetic fluff. HOC is not a typical ads mill; the studio architects brands. It dissects a business, removes clutter, and rebuilds visual prestige. Positioning is Premium Minimalism and direct, human-centric marketing.

Practices: visual identities, social media, account management, marketing, paid ads, exhibitions and conferences, event management, booth design, filming and editing, promo gifts, roadside ads, websites and ecommerce, app design, financial analysis.

## How to hire

Start on Telegram or WhatsApp from https://hoc.agency/.
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/963954187154
The studio sends a quotation. Payment details are confirmed on WhatsApp before work begins. There is no self-serve web checkout and no public client portal.

## FAQ (same as https://hoc.agency/#faq)

Q: What is Home of Creativity (HOC)? / ما هو بيت الإبداع (HOC)؟
A: Home of Creativity is a visual-identity and brand-architecture agency in Al Hamra, Damascus. We also design brand identity for clients in Riyadh. The official website is hoc.agency.

Q: What services does Home of Creativity offer? / ما خدمات بيت الإبداع؟
A: Visual identities, social media, account management, marketing, paid ads, exhibitions and conferences, event management, booth design, filming and editing, promo gifts, roadside ads, websites and ecommerce, app design, and financial analysis.

Q: How do I start a project with HOC? / كيف أبدأ مشروعاً مع بيت الإبداع؟
A: Start on Telegram or WhatsApp from hoc.agency. The studio sends a quotation; payment details are confirmed on WhatsApp before work begins. There is no self-serve web checkout.

Q: Where is Home of Creativity located? / أين يقع بيت الإبداع؟
A: The studio is in Al Hamra, Damascus, Syria. The team also designs brand identity for clients in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The public map is at hoc.agency/locations/ (Damascus, Al Hamra).

Q: Are HOC, hoc, Home, بيت الإبداع, and Creativation Source the same agency?
A: Yes. They all refer to the same agency at hoc.agency.
